TRIVUJ মানে গান ft. Aithrios

Trivuj is bringing Aithrios to Raleigh for a night of Bengali rock at Cannonball Music Hall. Based in the Maryland/DC area, Aithrios plays a mix of original songs and covers from bands like Artcell, LRB, Warfaze, Nemesis, and Miles. If Bengali rock has a place in your playlist, this is a chance to hear it live.

Trivuj – Triangle Music Project started with a simple idea: bring people together through Bengali music. We want to keep Bangla music alive in our community, give musicians opportunities to perform, and create spaces where music lovers can connect. From jam sessions to live concerts, Trivuj মানে গান is about the music and the people who make it matter.

Join us on Saturday, November 21, for a night of live rock and a gathering of the Bengali music community in the Triangle.

Event Details

Date: Saturday, November 21, 2026

Doors Open: 7:30 PM

Venue: Cannonball Music Hall

Address: 2304 Atlantic Ave, Raleigh, NC 27604

Please Note: This is a standing-room-only event. No seating will be available, so plan accordingly.
